faq.subtitle: [FIL]Everything you need to know about SeaVoice[FIL] AI and how it can transform your business communications

q1.question: [FIL]How does SeaVoice[FIL] differ from a traditional chatbot?
q1.answer: SeaVoice[FIL] provides real-time voice conversations with advanced AI that can understand context, handle interruptions, and deliver human-like responses over the phone. Unlike text-based chatbots, SeaVoice[FIL] handles actual voice calls with natural speech patterns.

q2.question: [FIL]How long does it take to set up?
q2.answer: [FIL]Setup typically takes less than 20 minutes. You can train your voice agent, connect your phone system, set up call rules, and go live in one session.

q3.question: [FIL]Can callers tell they're speaking with an AI?
q3.answer: [FIL]Our advanced voice technology creates very human-like conversations. While some callers may notice, most find the experience natural and helpful. You can also customize the AI to introduce itself as an AI assistant if preferred.

q4.question: [FIL]What happens if SeaVoice[FIL] can't answer a question?
q4.answer: SeaVoice[FIL] is designed to handle escalations gracefully. It can transfer calls to human agents, take messages, schedule callbacks, or direct callers to appropriate resources based on your configured rules.

q5.question: [FIL]How does pricing work?
q5.answer: [FIL]We offer transparent per-minute pricing. Premium plans include base minutes with additional usage billed per minute. Enterprise plans are customized based on volume and specific needs.

q6.question: [FIL]Can I customize the AI's voice?
q6.answer: [FIL]Yes! You can choose from multiple voice options, adjust tone and speaking style, and even clone custom voices for Enterprise plans. The AI can be trained to match your brand's communication style.

q7.question: [FIL]Is SeaVoice[FIL] multilingual?
q7.answer: [FIL]Yes, SeaVoice[FIL] supports conversations in over 10 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, and Japanese.

q8.question: [FIL]What industries benefit most from SeaVoice[FIL]?
q8.answer: SeaVoice[FIL] works well across industries including healthcare, real estate, hospitality, financial services, e-commerce, professional services, and any business that handles high call volumes or needs 24/7 availability.

q9.question: [FIL]Can SeaVoice[FIL] handle emergency calls?
q9.answer: [FIL]While SeaVoice[FIL] can handle urgent inquiries and escalate appropriately, we recommend maintaining direct emergency protocols. SeaVoice[FIL] can be configured to immediately transfer emergency-related calls to human operators.

q10.question: [FIL]Can SeaVoice[FIL] detect spam calls?
q10.answer: [FIL]Yes, SeaVoice[FIL] includes built-in spam detection that can identify and filter suspicious calls, protecting your business from unwanted interruptions while ensuring legitimate calls get through.

q11.question: [FIL]How do I get started?
q11.answer: [FIL]Getting started is easy! Book a demo to see SeaVoice[FIL] in action, then our team will help you set up your voice agent, integrate with your phone system, and configure it for your specific needs. Most customers are up and running within a day.

faq.question1: [FIL]How does SeaVoice[FIL] pricing relate to SeaChat[FIL] and SeaX[FIL]?
faq.answer1: SeaVoice[FIL] Inbound Only plan ($29.99/month) is based on SeaChat[FIL] Premium plan, focusing on inbound voice AI. faq.question2: [FIL]What's the difference between Inbound Only and Inbound + Outbound plans?
faq.answer2: [FIL]Inbound Only ($29.99/month) handles incoming calls with AI, perfect for customer service. Inbound + Outbound ($99/month for first user) adds bulk campaign capabilities and outbound calling, ideal for sales and marketing teams running large-scale voice campaigns.
faq.question3: [FIL]Can I keep my existing business phone numbers?
faq.answer3: [FIL]Yes, you can keep your existing business numbers and forward calls to SeaVoice[FIL], or we can provide new numbers. Each phone number costs $2-$3/month with E911 address registration.
faq.question4: [FIL]How much do voice AI calls actually cost?
faq.answer4: [FIL]All voice AI calls start at $0.12 per minute using the ChatGPT-4o mini model. This is the same rate across SeaChat[FIL] Premium and SeaVoice[FIL] plans. Higher-tier models like ChatGPT-4o cost $0.80 per minute and are available on custom plans.
faq.question5: [FIL]What happens when contacts call back after an outbound campaign?
faq.answer5: [FIL]With the Inbound + Outbound plan, when contacts call back after receiving campaign calls, our inbound Voice AI will automatically handle these calls, providing seamless continuity in your customer communications.
faq.question6: [FIL]Can I upgrade from Inbound Only to Inbound + Outbound?
faq.answer6: [FIL]Absolutely! You can upgrade your plan at any time. The upgrade takes effect immediately, and you'll gain access to outbound calling, campaign features, and additional user seats.
faq.question7: [FIL]Do you offer volume discounts for high-usage customers?
